summary: Release Hybrid 70% denominator includes every declared QID owner, including complex or unsupported raster fallback; every fallback requires explicit audit.
invariants: Every declared QID owner remains in the denominator regardless of native capability support.
Development exports remain compatible when no release profile is persisted.
Release requires explicit nonempty fallback reasons and no denominator-shrinking eligibility flag.
forbidden: Do not exclude complex, unsupported, slide, or raster fallback owners to reach the 0.70 gate.
